title: Dragging a text file to e.g. kate in the Quicklauncher doesn't open kate but inserts the file next to it
line: Dropping a file onto an app in Quick Launch now opens the file with that app.
explanation: Quick Launch treated every external drop as "add a launcher": hovering an app opened a gap and dropping a file there never opened it with the app. On master the drop did nothing at all, because since b93257b99 the insert runs in Qt.callLater and the saved event.mimeData.urls array is already empty by then (logged: 1 url at drop, 0 when inserting). The URLs are now copied to plain strings before deferring (also in the popup), and when the dragged items are not .desktop files and the pointer is over an application launcher, that launcher is highlighted instead of opening a gap and the files are opened with it through KIO::ApplicationLauncherJob.

commits.message:
applets/quicklaunch: open files dropped on an application launcher

Dropping a file on Quicklaunch always made room for a new launcher, and
on release nothing was added because the saved URL list was empty by the
time it was inserted. Open the files with the hovered app instead.

BUG: 475312

media.caption: Master: a .txt dragged from the desktop onto the Text Viewer launcher; the widget opens a gap, and on release nothing opens and nothing is added.
Fixed: same drag; no gap, and on release the file opens in Text Viewer (a Konsole showing its contents).
Master, while hovering the launcher: the tray shifts left because Quick Launch makes room for a new launcher.
Fixed, while hovering the launcher: no gap opens.
Master after the drop: nothing opened.
Fixed after the drop: the dropped file is open in the app.
Fixed: the app under the pointer is highlighted as the drop target (launchers a.txt, Text Viewer, b.txt).

review.text: Opening non-.desktop files dropped onto an application launcher via KIO::ApplicationLauncherJob (accepting Qt.CopyAction to prevent unintended moves) and highlighting the hovered target cleanly fixes the reported regression while keeping .desktop drops, file-launcher drops, and internal reordering working. Copying event.mimeData.urls to plain strings before Qt.callLater in main.qml and Popup.qml also fixes the broken deferred insertion on master, and the video and screenshots verify the full drag-and-drop flow.

reviews.text: Opening non-.desktop files dropped onto an application launcher via KIO::ApplicationLauncherJob (accepting Qt.CopyAction to prevent unintended moves) and highlighting the hovered target cleanly fixes the reported regression while keeping .desktop drops, file-launcher drops, and internal reordering working. Copying event.mimeData.urls to plain strings before Qt.callLater in main.qml and Popup.qml also fixes the broken deferred insertion on master, and the video and screenshots verify the full drag-and-drop flow.

Does what the reporter asked: a file dropped on an application launcher now opens with that app through KIO::ApplicationLauncherJob, and the app is highlighted instead of a gap opening. It also fixes the empty-URL regression from the Qt.callLater deferral, in both the panel and the popup. Index bookkeeping around the drop marker is correct, CopyAction avoids moving the source file, and .desktop files and file launchers still insert as before. The trade-off that a plain file can't be added as a launcher by dropping it on an app (as in Task Manager) is reasonable and documented. The video and screenshots show the gap before and the file opening after.
